name: Kubota Enishi
source:
“I just like liking people. It’s more fun that way, and it makes you kinder, right? Whether there’s any real ‘feelings’ involved doesn’t really matter to me~”

Itose’s best friend (and bad influence), who considers himself Itose’s unofficial caretaker. Careless and prone to lying, with plenty of questionable traits—but extremely friendly and remarkably good at getting close to people. He has a wide social circle regardless of gender and a natural charm that draws people in. A “chameleon” artist who can handle all styles competently, yet precisely because of that versatility, he lacks a style of his own, something no one understands better than the man himself.

View on romance:

Chooses partners the way one chooses clothes, depending on the moment. “Never rejecting those who come, never chasing those who leave” sounds nice—but really, he just doesn’t get attached.

[Translated from the [url=https://lamina-pla.net/Keylabox/chara.html]official website[/url]]
